title: azalea albiflora
intro: Azalea albiflora, commonly known as the White Azalea or White Fragrant Azalea, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Ericaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and fever due to its health benefits. Azalea albiflora has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, and its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
